pos: The person remains standing in the exact center of the frame for the whole shot, looking exactly as in the reference frames: same face, same hairstyle, same clothing, same body shape. Feet planted on the ground, head level and still, with a barely perceptible, gentle breathing motion in the chest and shoulders. The facial expression is a calm, neutral, relaxed look that never changes: mouth softly closed, no smile, brows relaxed, eyes open and steady, looking directly at the camera. The camera is locked on a fixed tripod at a constant distance from the person: the distance never changes, the framing never changes, and the person's apparent size stays exactly the same from the first frame to the last, with no zoom-in, no zoom-out, no push-in, no pull-out, no dolly and no drift of any kind. The background is completely static and rock-steady: every wall, door, floor tile and object stays locked in its exact position with zero movement, zero wobble, zero shimmer and zero flicker for the entire shot, exactly matching the reference frames. The mouth stays completely closed for the entire shot: lips gently pressed together, jaw relaxed and motionless, teeth and tongue never visible. The person does not talk, does not speak, does not laugh out loud, does not yawn and never opens the mouth at any point; this is a silent, wordless pose transition only. The background stays exactly as in the reference frames: each element holding the same position, shape and brightness throughout, with no new objects and no environment changes. The lighting, brightness and colors match the reference frames exactly. The camera is locked off on a tripod: it holds the same angle, position and framing for the entire duration, with no pan, no zoom, no shake and no drift, keeping the person at exactly the same apparent size and distance. The only other movement is the smooth, gradual ease into the exact pose of the final reference frame. Motion continues softly through the entire shot and up to the very last frame: the chest and shoulders keep a subtle, continuous breathing sway even after the final pose is reached. There is no frozen hold, no still tail, no long pause and no motionless ending at any point.
